## 4 · Optional detail and memory / 可选细节与显存
Keep Tail/Bias/STG/Restart OFF for upstream parity. They alter the HIGH refine path and require a separate A/B review. Learned latent upscale saves first-pass compute, not the high-resolution peak VRAM. `offload_after` releases only the learned resizer.
nodes.title: 4 · Optional detail and memory / 可选细节与显存

widgets_values:
## 5 · Known-good starting values / 建议参数
LOW `736x416x124`; scale mode `scale_by`; scale `2.0`; output `1472x832`; video/audio shift `12/3`; base/coarse/refine `8/4/3`; Euler; all optional detail toggles OFF. Use only the `_comfyui_alpha8` LightX2V conversion; the superseded plain `_comfyui` file applies 16x excessive LoRA strength and destroys frames.
nodes.title: 5 · Starting values / 建议参数

widgets_values:
## 3 · Required pass handoff + audio clock / 二采接线与音频时钟
Pass 1 must feed `denoised_output` into the learned upscaler. HIGH Conditioning is rebuilt after the upscaler reports its actual aligned size, then Reconcile verifies the contract. Keep Reconcile at `second_pass_audio_source=legacy_policy` for native author parity: pass 2 must complete both video and audio. The custom dual-clock sampler rebases the partial pass-2 audio start from video sigma onto its own audio sigma before the first model call. Do not insert Two-Pass Audio Audit here; that node is only for an intentional zero-mask source lock. AV Decode receives the pass-2 sampler output directly.
nodes.title: 3 · Required pass handoff / 二采接线

widgets_values:
## 2 · Automatic size synchronization / 尺寸自动同步
Change only Learned Latent Upscale `scale_by`. Its `width` and `height` outputs are already connected to HIGH Conditioning. Do not create a second manual width/height. Default `2.0x` turns the LOW `736x416` latent into `1472x832`.

subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the young woman in <Picture 1>, with long black hair in an elaborate updo adorned with pearl hairpins and a butterfly hairpin, a jade necklace with a green pendant, and a flowing red-orange hanfu with white floral embroidery; in the target video she wields an iron-bone folding fan as her combat weapon.
<Subject 2> is the young man in <Picture 2>, with long black hair in a topknot secured by a jade hairpin, a white inner robe under a light cyan outer robe with dark teal trim, and a straight sword with a brown handle and gold pommel; in the target video he draws and wields the sword.

summary:
[reference generation] The target video is a 15-second cinematic martial-arts fight between <Subject 1> and <Subject 2> on a moonlit stone battle platform atop a mountain cliff. The fight opens mid-combat and runs at high speed with continuous attacks, parries, and counters, large spatial movement including sprints, vertical wall-runs, and mid-air crossings, and high-end game-CG-style energy effects — ripples, shockwave rings, trails, and debris — emitted only from weapon impacts. It ends with a decisive disarming finisher.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1] through [Shot 7]): fully_preserved - her face, elaborate updo with pearl and butterfly hairpins, jade necklace with green pendant, red-orange hanfu with white floral embroidery, and folding fan are retained; the fan is recontextualized as an iron-bone combat weapon, which is an action change rather than a loss of reference fidelity.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1] through [Shot 7]): fully_preserved - his face, topknot with jade hairpin, white inner robe, light cyan outer robe with dark teal trim, and straight sword are retained; he draws the sword from its sheath for combat, which is an action change rather than a loss of reference fidelity.

detailed_description:
The target video uses a cinematic live-action style blended with high-end game-CG quality visual effects, shot on ARRI Alexa with 35mm anamorphic lenses and fine film grain; cool cyan moonlight contrasts with warm red lantern light, with volumetric beams and high contrast. All energy effects — auras, trails, shockwave rings, and debris — are physically integrated and emitted only from weapon impacts.
[Shot 1] A wide low-angle shot frames a massive stone battle platform on a mountain cliff at night, under a full moon, with four carved stone pillars and swaying red lanterns; <Subject 1> and <Subject 2> are already locked in combat. The camera trucks left with large amplitude at fast speed as <Subject 2> sprints forward and slashes horizontally with his drawn straight sword, the blade trailing a sharp cyan energy arc. <Subject 1> snaps her iron-bone folding fan open to block; the collision emits an expanding red-and-cyan energy ripple and a shockwave ring that lifts dust and dead leaves off the stone. She deflects his blade, spins, and strikes with the closed fan in a backhand slash leaving a thin red trail; <Subject 2> ducks under it.
[Shot 2] At 00:02.000, the shot cuts to a whip-pan medium shot following <Subject 1> as she sprints across the platform, then runs vertically up a carved stone pillar — her boots scrape sparks and small stone chips off the wet surface — before flipping off the top and descending with a fan slash that trails a thick red energy ribbon. <Subject 2> launches upward to meet her with an upward sword thrust; their weapons collide mid-air in a cross-shaped red-and-cyan energy burst, sending a shockwave ring outward. Both land hard on opposite sides of the platform as stone fragments rain down from the pillar.
[Shot 3] At 00:04.200, the shot cuts to a side tracking shot at fast speed: both fighters burst into a full sprint toward each other and cross paths at high speed, trading three rapid strikes — fan, sword, fan — as they pass. Each collision emits a small energy ripple and a shower of orange sparks, leaving crisscrossing red and cyan energy trails hanging in the air. They skid to a stop on opposite sides and instantly turn; the combined shockwave of their passing shatters a stone lantern between them, its fragments exploding outward in a burst of dust and glowing embers.
[Shot 4] At 00:06.400, the shot cuts to a tight handheld close-up with strong shake as <Subject 2> unleashes a rapid sword combo — thrust, horizontal slash, downward cut. <Subject 1> blocks each strike with the iron ribs of her open fan, each block emitting a compact red energy pulse that ripples across the fan's surface. She catches his wrist, twists, and hurls him into a stone pillar; the pillar cracks with a burst of cyan energy and a cloud of dust. <Subject 2> rolls out of the debris and kicks a loose stone fragment as a projectile; <Subject 1> snaps her fan open and releases a focused red energy wave that deflects the stone, which shatters against the energy into fine powder.
[Shot 5] At 00:08.600, the shot cuts to a wide aerial shot pulling back with large amplitude at fast speed: <Subject 1> leaps high, her fan trailing a red energy ribbon as she arcs over the platform above the cliff edge, and <Subject 2> launches to meet her, his sword trailing a cyan energy tail. They cross mid-air, trading two rapid clashes that each send a shockwave ring expanding through the mist, then both slam down onto the platform simultaneously. The impact creates a massive ground shockwave — a ring of red and cyan energy expanding outward — while the stone cracks in a radial pattern and dust, debris, and leaves explode upward.
[Shot 6] At 00:10.800, the shot cuts to a tracking shot driving forward at fast speed as <Subject 2> presses relentlessly, driving <Subject 1> backward with a flurry of sword thrusts, each thrust leaving a short cyan energy pierce trail in the air. <Subject 1> retreats, blocking each strike, her feet skidding across the wet stone until she nears the cliff edge. At the last moment she sidesteps, hooks his sword arm with the spine of her fan, and pivots, hurling him toward the edge; <Subject 2> catches himself on the stone railing, which cracks under the impact, then flips back onto the platform with a cyan energy burst from his landing.
[Shot 7] At 00:13.000, the shot cuts to a crash zoom onto <Subject 2> as he charges with a full-power descending sword strike, the blade wrapped in a dense cyan energy aura and trailing a thick cyan energy tail. <Subject 1> plants her feet, snaps her fan fully open, and a concentrated red energy barrier forms across the fan's surface. She meets his strike head-on; the collision creates a blinding red-and-cyan energy burst and a massive shockwave ring that flattens the surrounding dust and cracks the platform in a wide radius. For a beat they are locked, then <Subject 1> twists the fan, disarms his sword — it flies spinning away trailing cyan energy — and drives the closed fan into his chest in a single decisive thrust. A red energy pulse erupts from the impact point; <Subject 2> is launched backward, skidding across the stone, and comes to rest on one knee, defeated. <Subject 1> stands over him, fan half-open, red energy dissipating from its iron ribs, as moonlight illuminates the ruined platform.

overall_soundscape:
Night wind sweeps across the cliffside platform with distant mountain ambience, punctuated by the sharp snap of the folding fan opening and closing, the whoosh of flowing hanfu sleeves, and ringing steel-and-iron clashes. Stone pillars crack, lanterns shatter, and the platform fractures under heavy impacts, while both fighters trade short, controlled breaths and restrained grunts; the disarmed sword hisses through the air before clattering against the stone.

non_diegetic_music:
A hybrid taiko-and-electronic score at a relentless fast tempo, with pounding low drums, a driving string ostinato, and stabbing synth brass that accelerates through every clash; risers swell on each high leap, then a massive sub-bass impact hit lands on the final weapon-lock, cutting to near-silence — only wind and breathing — as the finisher lands and the fight ends.
A woman in red Hanfu spins rapidly through the night sky, flowing silk and synchronized wind ambience, cinematic lighting.
